connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: A connection to a Jakarta JMS 3.x messaging broker (e.g. ActiveMQ Artemis, TIBCO EMS, IBM MQ, Oracle AQ)
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 連接到 Jakarta JMS 3.x 訊息代理伺服器（例如：ActiveMQ Artemis、TIBCO EMS、IBM MQ、Oracle AQ）

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Connection timeout in milliseconds; used for ping/connection test
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 連接逾時時間（毫秒）；用於 ping/連接測試

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Fully-qualified Java class name of the JMS ConnectionFactory implementation (e.g. `org.apache.activemq.artemis.jms.client.ActiveMQConnectionFactory`)
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: JMS ConnectionFactory 實作的完整 Java 類別名稱（例如 `org.apache.activemq.artemis.jms.client.ActiveMQConnectionFactory`）

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Fully-qualified Java class name of the JMS ConnectionFactory
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: JMS ConnectionFactory 的完整 Java 類別名稱

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The JMS client ID; required for durable topic subscriptions
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: JMS 用戶端 ID；持久主題訂閱所必需

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The JMS client ID for durable subscriptions
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 用於持久訂閱的 JMS 用戶端 ID

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Maximum number of JMS sessions in the session pool
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 連接池中 JMS 會話的最大數量

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Maximum number of pooled JMS sessions
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 併發 JMS 會話的最大數量

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The session automatically acknowledges a client's receipt of a message either when the session has successfully returned from a call to receive or when the message listener the session has called to process the message successfully returns
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 會話在成功從 receive 呼叫返回時，或在處理訊息的訊息監聽器成功返回時，自動確認客戶端已接收訊息

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The client acknowledges a consumed message by calling the message's acknowledge method. Acknowledging a consumed message acknowledges all messages that the session has consumed
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 客戶端透過呼叫訊息的 acknowledge 方法來確認已消耗的訊息。確認已消耗的訊息會同時確認該會話已消耗的所有訊息

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The session lazily acknowledges the delivery of messages. This is likely to result in the delivery of some duplicate messages if the JMS provider fails, so it should only be used by consumers that can tolerate duplicate messages
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 會話延遲確認訊息的傳遞。如果 JMS 提供者發生故障，可能會導致部分訊息重複傳遞，因此僅適用於可容忍重複訊息的消費者

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The session is transacted; messages are delivered in a transaction and must be committed or rolled back
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 會話為交易模式；訊息以交易方式傳遞，必須提交或回滾

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The password for authentication with the JMS broker; if any
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 用於與 JMS broker 認證的密碼；如有

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Comma-separated list of JAR files or directories to add to the classpath for the JMS provider (e.g. the Artemis client JARs)
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 用於 JMS 提供者（例如 Artemis 客戶端 JAR 檔案）的類路徑，以逗號分隔的 JAR 檔案或目錄清單

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: Comma-separated list of JAR files or directories for the JMS provider
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 用於 JMS 提供者的 JAR 檔案或目錄清單，以逗號分隔

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The username for authentication with the JMS broker; if any
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 用於與 JMS 代理伺服器驗證的使用者名稱；如有
用於驗證的使用者名稱

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: A connection to a Jakarta JMS messaging broker
connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.message: 連線至 Jakarta JMS 訊息代理伺服器
